pins.tip: Ask for a sixth floor room on the Kléber side. The rooftop bar has the Eiffel Tower straight ahead and is open to hotel guests first.
Rooms facing the Tuileries are worth the difference. Have the pastries at Le Dalí once, even if you skip breakfast.
The Concorde facing rooms are the reason to stay here. The pool in the basement is quiet before ten.
Courtyard rooms are quieter than the avenue side. The bar turns into the best people watching in Paris after nine.
Book afternoon tea when you book the room; it fills weeks ahead. Green Park side rooms get the morning light.
Ten minutes on foot to Oxford Circus and still quiet at night. Tea in the Palm Court is the one to book.
River view rooms are worth it at Christmas. The American Bar opens at noon and you will not need a reservation then.
Every room is a duplex suite. Book the beach cabana early in December; the terrace pool is calmer than the main one.
Water park entry is included with the room; go in the first hour. Ask for the Palm side for the skyline at night.
Park view rooms on a high floor, or do not bother upgrading. The food hall downstairs is open until late.
The infinity pool is for hotel guests only; go at seven in the morning. City view rooms beat the harbor side at night.
Every room is a suite with a butler. Skip the queue at the Long Bar by going before five.
Pay for the Bosphorus view; the garden side looks at a wall. The heated infinity pool is open all winter.
Room 411 is the Agatha Christie room if you ask early. Five minutes on foot to İstiklal, and the bar is from 1892.
Garden view rooms face the Atlas on a clear morning. The gardens are the reason to stay; breakfast out there in winter sun.
River view rooms only. The hotel boat goes to the Rijksmuseum, which is the best way into the city in winter.
The rooftop pool looks at Sagrada Família. Casa Batlló is a three minute walk; book the first slot of the day.
Sea view above the 20th floor. The beach is across the road, the old town a ten minute taxi.
The sail is on the beach, so every room sees the sea. Eclipse bar on the 26th floor for sunset.
Via Veneto is quiet at night and Villa Borghese is at the end of the street. Corner rooms under the dome have the view.
The New Year fireworks are right in front of the hotel. Book the beach side; the pool deck is the best seat in Rio.
Afternoon tea on the terrace is the ritual; book it when you book the room. Sea facing rooms are worth the step up.
Stay in the palace wing, not the garden annex. The garden pool is open all year.

collections.subtitle: Four nights over New Year, 29 December to 2 January, two adults. Where the fireworks are.

collections.subtitle: Four nights, 22 to 26 December, two adults. Markets, lights and long lunches.
